method: All 245 complete Italian source paragraphs and all 224 notes were read. Individually authored paragraph explanations supply the source-ordered reader and selected concept reasoning; the shared prose retains explicit local references. Compared agency, polarity, certainty, conditions, normative attribution, argument sequence and protected qualifications. No external factual update or native-speaker proofreading is claimed. Hashes bind this review to the current authored text and exact frozen source bodies; they do not independently prove semantic fidelity.
